name: rust-book-narrated
description: Astro/Starlight companion site for The Rust Programming Language (Brown CS 'quizzed' edition), with a Kokoro-JS narrator and original per-chapter exercises. Book text + quizzes are cloned and transformed at build time — nothing is vendored. See ATTRIBUTION.md.

scripts.build-narrator: cd narrator && npm install && npm test && npm run build && cp dist/narrator.bundle.js ../public/narrator.bundle.js && cp src/narrator.css ../src/styles/narrator.css
scripts.prebuild: npm run build-narrator && npm run fetch-book && npm run check-vocabulary
